deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is a draft of what became §12 ('Klassen algebraischer Functionen; Moduln') of Riemann's Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen (Crelle 54, 1857). The previous page sets up the count. If z is a μ-valued function on the (2p+1)-fold connected surface T (genus p), simply infinite at μ points, then by Riemann–Hurwitz it has 2(μ+p−1) branch values. By Riemann–Roch, z contains 2μ−p+1 arbitrary constants, assuming μ is large enough (μ ≥ 2p−1 is my condition).

Part 1 (top of page). Fix a class, i.e. a birational equivalence class or Riemann surface. There are then only finitely many systems of μ-valued functions z in which 2μ−p+1 of the branch values take prescribed values. The reason is that the conditions on the constants are algebraic. Conversely, if 2μ−p+1 branch points of a μ-sheeted genus-p surface are given arbitrarily, there always exists a system of algebraic functions of z branched at them. The remaining branch values are then arbitrary and determine a class. Their number is
2(μ+p−1) − (2μ−p+1) = 3p−3,
so a class depends on 3p−3 continuous moduli.

Part 2 (middle). Riemann qualifies the count. It holds only if 2μ−p+1 of the branch values are independent functions of the free constants in z. He says this holds when p>1, giving 3p−3 moduli. A crossed-out line treats p=1: all branch values can be prescribed, yet the number of moduli is 1. In modern terms the constants do not act effectively, because translations of the elliptic curve form a 1-dimensional automorphism group. To settle the question, he proposes to use as independent variable not one of the algebraic functions but an everywhere-finite integral w (a holomorphic abelian integral).

Part 3 (bottom). Consider the image of the cut surface T' under w. Its values are represented by a surface S covering a finite part of the w-plane once or several times. The boundary of S consists of pairs of parallel line pieces, each pair the image of the two banks of one cross-cut. Across the ν-th cross-cut, w is larger on the positive side than on the negative side by the period K^(ν). So corresponding points on the two parallel boundary pieces differ by the translation K^(ν).

Next page continues: S has 2p−2 simple branch points, since dw has 2p−2 zeros. Rational functions of s,z become functions on S taking equal values at corresponding boundary points. Choosing the normalisation of w then gives the 3p−3 count again.
errors: No mathematical errors on the page. Riemann himself flags that the naive count needs independence of the branch values and handles p=1 separately; this is correct.
The parameter-counting argument (independence of branch values as functions of the constants) is asserted, not proved here. Riemann's proposed route via the integral w is only sketched on this page.

results.what: Number of moduli of a class of algebraic functions of genus p is 3p−3 (p>1), obtained as (number of branch points 2(μ+p−1)) minus (free constants 2μ−p+1)
results.modern_name: dim M_g = 3g−3 via Hurwitz-space parameter count

results.what: Exceptional case p=1: number of moduli is 1, not 0
results.modern_name: dim M_{1,1} = 1; correction by dim Aut (dim H^1(T_X) − dim H^0(T_X) = 3g−3)

results.what: Image of the cut surface T' under a holomorphic integral w is a surface S whose boundary consists of pairs of parallel curves identified by translation by the periods K^(ν)
results.modern_name: Developing / period map of a holomorphic differential (flat structure, translation surface picture)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working draft of the published §12 of Riemann's 1857 Abelian functions paper (moduli count 3p−3, p=1 exception, image surface S of an integral w). Its interest lies in the drafting process, not in new results.

transcription_corrections: 'Systemen p werthiger Functionen' should read 'Systemen μ werthiger Functionen' (μ-valued); the letter μ has been misread as p throughout.
'2p+p+1 Verzweigungswerthe' should be '2μ−p+1 Verzweigungswerthe' (number of free constants).
'{+die 2p+p-1 Verzweigungspunkte+} einer ... p fach bedeckenden' should be 'die 2μ−p+1 Verzweigungspunkte einer ... μ fach bedeckenden (2p+1)fach zusammenhängenden Fläche'.
'dass es 2p-p+1 Verzweigungswerthe giebt' should be '2μ−p+1 Verzweigungswerthe'.
The crossed-out p=1 passage ends 'und die Anzahl der Moduln ist dann =1', consistent with the published text.
